dedupe_keys.name: evolution des temps de parcours des trains

description: Evolution des temps de parcours des trains is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Ce jeu de données présente l'évolution du temps de parcours, calculé en minutes, entre les plus grandes villes françaises via le réseau ferroviaire depuis 1920. Le meilleur temps de parcours proposé sur la relation est retenu. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Informations institutionnelles et financières. Its keywords are Temps de parcours, Trajet, Trafic. The portal shows 2016-12-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
